contracts.t: Procurement of seven (7) metering regulation stations (MRS) with capacity of 100 nm3/h, four (4) MRS with capacity of 500 nm3/h, one (1) MRS with capacity of 1 000 nm3/h, one (1) MRS with capacity of 2 500 nm3/h, one (1) MRS with capacity of 22 500 nm3/h for ТО West Skopje, and one (1) main MRS with capacity of 30 000 nm3/h for distribution gas pipeline and connection of TAV airport, Logistics Center and Pekabesko.
